thread:
maria: FYI handoff for orion-13b weights. HF path is `hf://redwood/orion-13b/v1` but we need the S3 mirror + checksum verify before we tag for serving. Can someone take ownership of the mirror job?

sam: I can take it. Quick question — do we want full shard manifests or a single monolithic weights file for this one?

maria: Sharded. Ops wants the same shard layout as upstream so the runtime can stream KV caches. Manifest should include `sha256` per shard.

leo: pinging infra: do we already have the s3 prefix reserved for `orion-13b/v1/`? need bucket ACLs and lifecycle.

ryan: Bucket `s3://redwood-models-prod/orion-13b/v1/` exists but ACL is private. I can add a bucket policy for the ingest role. Which role should mirror-bot assume?

sam: use `ingest-runner@redwood` role. Also we should presign shard download URLs with TTL 1h for initial testing.

maria: perf requirement: each shard must be <= 2GB to avoid long cold downloads. Also note tokenizer note: upstream tokenizer uses old `spm` vocab order — our tokenization tests flagged 3 tokens mapped differently in the special tokens set. See test output.

leo: ugh — is it the `|pad|` vs `▁` issue again? can you paste the failing sample?

maria: failing sample below. quick repro: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('▁test').tokens)"`

sam: thanks. I adjusted tokenizer config to map special tokens to our canonical forms and added a compatibility shim in the serving loader. But we need a deterministic tokenizer checksum in the manifest (sha256 of `tokenizer.json`) so we can alert on mismatches.

ingest-bot: Mirror job started by sam at 2076543225

ingest-bot: Logs:
```
START mirror orion-13b v1
fetch hf://redwood/orion-13b/v1/weights-00001.safetensors -> /tmp/ingest/00001
sha256(00001) = e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4b...
uploaded to s3://redwood-models-prod/orion-13b/v1/weights-00001.safetensors
```

ryan: I pushed a manifest draft to the registry branch `models/orion-13b/v1/manifest-draft` (PR: https://git.redwood.internal/models/123). Manifest contains fields: `shards`, `size_bytes`, `sha256`, `tokenizer_checksum`, `created_by`, `origin`.

sam: quick CR ping @leo and @maria — small change to manifest schema: add `serve_compat: ["runtime-v2"]` so the rollout job can pick model variants that the runtime understands.

leo: LGTM for schema change, but add a short note in the PR about tokenizer shim and how we'll detect regressions.

maria: done. Also note for onboarding checklist: run `./ci/validate-manifest.sh manifest.json` locally. It checks shard sizes, checksums, and tokenizer checksum against `tokenizer.json`.

sam: running validator now...
```
$ ./ci/validate-manifest.sh manifest.json
Checking shards... OK (10 shards)
Tokenizer checksum matches manifest: OK
All checks passed
```

maria: awesome. after sam finishes full mirror and we confirm checksums, I'll create a canary deployment for orion-13b/v1 on dedicated infra. tagging milestones in the product board. :tada:

ryan: reminder — set manifest ACL to `registry-read` and S3 objects to `ingest-role-read` so dedicated nodes can fetch but artifacts remain private.

ingest-bot: Mirror job completed at 2076543270 — exit 0, uploaded 10 shards, created manifest `s3://redwood-models-prod/orion-13b/v1/manifest.json`

maria: perfect. thanks @sam and @ryan. I'll kick off the canary tomorrow and post results in #eng-ml.

leo: thanks all — noted for post-onboarding retro: add a small CI step that diffs tokenizer token-to-id map to catch these earlier.

sam: +1, created ticket ML-482 for that.

maria: closing the loop — marking this thread as resolved for handoff. :white_check_mark:
